title: Mundicunae Apothecary
description: A green-haired witch with pale skin and a cream robe stands behind a marble apothecary counter, carefully stirring a glowing golden potion in a black bowl with a spoon. The shop is filled with dozens of lit red candles, colorful potion bottles on wooden shelves, hanging herbs, an open spellbook with red wax seals, gold coins, and mystical framed paintings on the purple wall beneath a wooden sign reading 'Mundicunae'.
